## 2025-03-03 - [Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in dynamically generated Webview HTML]
**Vulnerability:** Node IDs generated by AI and Animation Trigger Names parsed from the FD document were injected into the `.innerHTML` of dynamically created elements without escaping. Since they're essentially user/AI-controlled text, this allows arbitrary scripts to execute within the VS Code Webview context.
**Learning:** Even though the source of data might appear somewhat restricted (AI output for IDs or file parser output for animation triggers), anything representing a dynamic identifier must be sanitized when rendering to the DOM.
**Prevention:** Always use a utility like `escapeHtml()` when interpolating parsed strings into `.innerHTML`, or better yet, assign to `.textContent`.
